runners_data.name: An Bradan Feasa
runners_data.note: Strong closer who has been off for 166 days which is concerning, but has won twice on similar going and Alice Bond's claim reduces his burden.

runners_data.name: Mio Amico
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent recent form with two wins from last five starts, headgear applied suggests connections expect improvement.

runners_data.name: The Truant
runners_data.note: Front-rank horse whose form has been modest lately but James Glennon's 7lb claim makes him competitive at this level.

runners_data.name: Arc Zoosve
runners_data.note: In-form closer with four recent wins who handles this going well, racing off just a 10-day break which suggests confidence from connections.

runners_data.name: Bulldog Spirit
runners_data.note: Will lead throughout if allowed, though recent form is patchy and needs the others to come at him too late.

races.paceDynamic: Bulldog Spirit stands alone as the confirmed front-runner and will likely get an uncontested lead, setting a steady tempo over this staying trip. Mio Amico and The Truant may track in second and third, but neither has the speed or inclination to pressure early. The lack of genuine pace pressure means the race will develop into a tactical affair where those who can quicken late will benefit most. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a finishing kick, as the slow early gallop will set up a sprint finish where tactical positioning matters more than sustained stamina.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Bulldog Spirit gets soft sectionals and isn't headed turning in
scenarios.body: The loose leader maintains just enough of his advantage through the final furlong as closers fail to reel him in quickly enough. Modest early fractions suit a horse who has shown front-running ability and whose trainer Bernard Llewellyn needs a breakthrough.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays genuinely slow and becomes a sprint
scenarios.body: Arc Zoosve's proven finishing kick and recent winning form allows him to power past tiring leaders in the final 100 yards. His four wins from 15 similar going starts and strong recent record make him perfectly suited to capitalize on a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Times Move
scenarios.trigger: If Mio Amico or The Truant track the leader closely and strike early
scenarios.body: A horse in second or third makes their move with 2-3 furlongs to run, getting first run on the field before the closers can respond. Mio Amico's recent good form and prominent style could work perfectly if he can time his challenge right.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses hit the front simultaneously in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The slow pace creates a bunched field turning for home where any horse can win in a driving finish. Polling Day's hold-up style could sneak through if the race becomes a complete lottery, though his recent form suggests he needs everything to fall perfectly.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Bulldog Spirit gets pressured early by The Truant or Mio Amico as he may not handle a genuine pace battle over this trip.
Monitor Arc Zoosve's position turning in as he needs room to unleash his finishing kick and could get trapped behind a slow pace.
Check how quickly Mio Amico travels early as his recent good form suggests he may be more forward than his prominent style indicates.
Observe An Bradan Feasa's jumping from the gates after his long 166-day absence which could leave him too much to do.
Watch for any significant market moves on Polling Day as his hold-up style suits but his recent form suggests he needs major improvement.

races.paceDynamic: Thestral and Grey Force will both show early speed from the gates, with Thestral likely taking them along at a solid clip through the early furlongs. Miss Starlet and Roccobear will sit handy in behind this pace, while the hold-up quartet of Lovethiswayagain, Slack Bob, Karmacy and Fuseboard will settle towards the rear. Over 7f on Lingfield's all-weather surface, the pace shouldn't be excessive but will be honest enough to set up the race properly. This race shape clearly favours the prominent runners who can sit close to the pace without having to make ground from too far back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Thestral and Grey Force set a steady but honest gallop without going too fast early
scenarios.body: Miss Starlet and Roccobear get perfect trips tracking the leaders and have too much pace for the hold-up horses to peg back. The handy runners get first run and sustain their kicks to the line.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays
scenarios.trigger: If Thestral gets an uncontested lead with Grey Force not showing his usual early pace
scenarios.body: The Hugo Palmer-trained runner gets soft fractions and has enough left to resist late challenges. Oisin Murphy's tactical nous keeps him clear of trouble and in the driving seat.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace between Thestral and Grey Force is stronger than expected and both tire
scenarios.body: Lovethiswayagain or Slack Bob get perfect pace to aim at and time their runs to perfection late. The class of these two shows as they pick off tired leaders.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes messy with the leaders going too fast or too slow early
scenarios.body: Grey Force benefits from his claimer's 3lb allowance and sustains his effort better than expected. Jack Callan gets him into a good rhythm and he outstays the field.

watchPoints.text: Thestral breaking smartly and getting an uncontested lead could prove decisive with Oisin Murphy's tactical awareness
Miss Starlet's fitness after 167 days off despite working well at home for the in-form Margarson yard
Grey Force and Thestral engaging in a pace duel early which would set up the race for closers
Roccobear's ability to get a good position from his draw as Marco Ghiani rarely gets him settled too far back
Lovethiswayagain's jumping from the gates as Billy Loughnane needs to get him into a rhythm quickly from his hold-up style

races.paceDynamic: Zatsgood and Special Ghaiyyath will dispute the early lead, with Frostmagic and Dontspoilasale likely settling just behind in prominent positions. This dual pace angle should create an honest gallop over the mile trip, stretching the field out through the middle stages. The presence of two willing front-runners means the early fractions will be solid rather than crawling, which should set up the race for the closers. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can finish off a true pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Zatsgood and Special Ghaiyyath duel too hard early and weaken
scenarios.body: The honest pace opens up perfect striking positions for the hold-up brigade coming from off the speed. Late runners with finishing kicks can sweep past the weakened pace-setters in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Frostmagic and Dontspoilasale track the pace without getting involved early
scenarios.body: They can capitalize on perfect tactical positions to strike when the leaders weaken but before the back-markers arrive. Their prominent style lets them pounce at the ideal moment.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Special Ghaiyyath or Zatsgood gets an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: One pace-setter can dictate fractions and kick clear when the others expect company, holding on from the closers' late surge. The leader's tactical advantage proves decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Crawl Suits Speed
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too slowly and create a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace turns this into a dash from the furlong pole where natural speed beats stamina. Horses with turn of foot rather than staying power prevail.

watchPoints.text: Watch how aggressively Zatsgood and Special Ghaiyyath go at each other early as their battle could set up the entire race.

Watch for Buy The Dip to be given plenty of room early to unleash his proven finishing effort from the rear.

races.paceDynamic: Barefoot Beach, Bela Sonata, and The Third Star will ensure a strong early gallop over this 7f trip. With 5 additional runners (Inside Story, Queue Dos, Brisk Symphony, Handle With Care, Bella Bisbee) wanting prominent positions, severe traffic problems are inevitable approaching the home turn. The sustained pace will stretch the field and test stamina reserves in the final 2f. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the early scrimmaging and finish with one sustained run.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong and the prominent brigade get into trouble
scenarios.body: The early pace burns out the leaders and creates traffic chaos for the prominent runners, allowing patient rides to sweep through. Ghisa and Bami benefit most from their patient tactics and lighter weights.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent horses can secure a clean run through
scenarios.body: Despite the pace and congestion, a well-positioned prominent runner avoids the worst traffic and kicks clear. Queue Dos or Brisk Symphony are best placed to capitalize on their recent form.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner stays strong
scenarios.trigger: If Barefoot Beach gets soft fractions despite the opposition
scenarios.body: The pace turns out more moderate than expected, allowing Barefoot Beach to control from the front. Her recent winning form and Sean Levey's booking suggests she can dictate terms successfully.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If all three leaders go too fast too early and stop dramatically
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop backfires spectacularly with all pace-setters fading badly. This creates a messy finish where any profile can win depending on racing luck rather than tactics.

watchPoints.text: Barefoot Beach, Bela Sonata, and The Third Star will create early pace pressure that could burn them all out
Traffic problems inevitable at the 3f pole as five prominent runners compete for limited racing room

Ghisa returning from 102-day break with headgear applied suggests connections expect significant improvement
Both Bami and The Third Star face fitness questions after lengthy absences in a race requiring peak condition

races.paceDynamic: Epictetus will lead from the start with no other confirmed front runners to challenge his early position. Penzance, Yaa Min, and Victors Spirit will track him in the prominent positions, creating a modest but sustainable gallop over this extended trip. The four hold-up horses (Twilight Moon, Lightning Tiger, Rogue Impact, Arth's Gold) will settle towards the rear and rely on a finishing kick. This controlled pace scenario strongly favours the prominent runners who can position close to Epictetus without expending energy, then kick clear when the hold-up horses are still gathering momentum.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If Epictetus sets a measured gallop without early pressure
scenarios.body: The prominent trackers get the perfect trip positioned within striking distance while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from too far back. Penzance and Yaa Min are ideally placed to exploit this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Epictetus maintains his lead unchallenged and finds extra
scenarios.body: His recent course-and-distance form at Lingfield gives him intimate knowledge of the track demands. The hold-up horses leave their runs too late on the testing climb to the finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge From Rear
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes overly sedate allowing time for closers
scenarios.body: Twilight Moon and Lightning Tiger get the perfect setup from their hold-up positions to unleash powerful finishing kicks. The early leaders begin to tire after setting fractions that prove too honest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Epictetus stops quickly leaving a tactical muddle
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the two-furlong pole with all running styles converging simultaneously. Form and class become the decisive factors rather than tactical positioning.
